conventions.source: a_plant.py (euler_rpy, step, fwd_loads) and a_aero.py (airframe) in redesign/qp/A/sitl; csv writer at a_plant.py 'frows.append'
conventions.time: t = plant clock, s (starts at 0.05 s); 10 Hz = the first plant sample at or after each 0.1 s tick (plant log rate about 19.7 Hz)
conventions.world_frame: NED. pn = north (m, +N), pe = east (m, +E) from the start point (pos[0], pos[1]); alt = up from the ground plane at the start, m (= -pos[2]). Hover start alt 0.314 m = fin feet on ground.
conventions.body_frame: FRD in cruise attitude: x nose (chord), y right wing, z belly. Hover = nose up (x_b up); copter forward = +z_b (belly), copter right = +y_b, copter down = -x_b (tail).
conventions.pitch_deg: pitch = asin(-x_b.z_world(down)) = angle of the nose above the horizon, deg: +90 = nose straight up (the hover / tailsitter stance), 0 = level cruise, +90 -> 0 in the forward transition.
conventions.roll_deg: roll = atan2(y_b.z, z_b.z), deg, about the nose axis; 0 = upright cruise, +ve = right wing down. Undefined (jumps 0/180) in hover at pitch 90 (gimbal): use only once pitch < ~80.
conventions.hdg_nose_deg: atan2(x_b.east, x_b.north), deg from north, clockwise; the nose heading. Undefined (0/180 jumps) while pitch is near 90; hdg_belly (not exported) is the copter-forward heading used in hover.
conventions.elevons_deg: dl = left elevon (-y wing, SERVO5), dr = right elevon (+y wing, SERVO6): checked in a_aero.airframe (Mx += EL_Y*FzR - EL_Y*FzL). Trailing edge DOWN positive, deg. Plant stops +-20 deg (EL_MAX), rate 300 deg/s, lag 0.04 s. (Servo pulse sign es5 = +1, es6 = -1.)
conventions.th1_4_N: thrust of motors 1..4 in N (after DOWNLOAD and HOT factors), the plant 'thr' list; motor positions/spin from a_plant mpos/mspin, X layout +-0.19 m y, +-0.13 m z.
conventions.V_ms: airspeed magnitude in the x-z body plane, sqrt(u^2+w^2) m/s (DG V, wind-relative)
conventions.alpha_deg: atan2(w, u) of the wind-relative velocity in body axes, deg; +ve = relative wind from below the nose
conventions.touch: number of the four fin-foot contact points below ground (0-4); 0 = airborne
conventions.pitch_use_15: per-sample |0.5(dl+dr)|/15 deg: mean elevon deflection as a share of 15 deg, the AR-015 / fwd_sum definition; _scalar holds the max over t_fbwa..t_cruise_end (fwd_sum.trans)
conventions.events: case.events.json is [] in every run (the plant logs events only when a cmd_file is used); marks / modes / events come from result.json (t = plant clock, mark times = driver clock st['t'])
